```skill ops-status-report
---
name: ops-status-report
description: Write a short status report for the Lumen operations team; use whenever asked for a report or status update
---
Team rule for every report:
1. The first line is `STATUS: <OK, AT RISK or BLOCKED>`. Choose OK when everything completed, AT RISK when something was skipped or delayed but has a recovery planned, and BLOCKED when work cannot proceed.
2. Keep the whole report to 5 lines or fewer.
3. The last line starts with `Next:` and names the next action.
4. Use only the facts the team gives. Add no preamble or closing remarks outside these lines.
```

Because that skill is a four-backtick block in the format, here it is again in the required form:

````skill ops-status-report
---
name: ops-status-report
description: Write a short status report for the Lumen operations team; use whenever asked for a report or status update
---
Team rule for every report:
1. The first line is `STATUS: <OK, AT RISK or BLOCKED>`. Choose OK when everything completed, AT RISK when something was skipped or delayed but has a recovery planned, and BLOCKED when work cannot proceed.
2. Keep the whole report to 5 lines or fewer.
3. The last line starts with `Next:` and names the next action.
4. Use only the facts the team gives. Add no preamble or closing remarks outside these lines.
````
